messages:
Alex R.: Quick coordination ask: we need to schedule a focused design session for the SDK auth flow + Console admin UX changes. I dropped a short pre-read and screenshots here: https://docs.internal/redwood/sdks/2026-sdk-auth-console-pre-read

Maria: Thanks. What are the validation goals? I want to be clear on API compatibility, migration UX, and operational hooks.

Alex R.: Goals: 1) settle the public API for server-side sessions and token rotation, 2) validate console admin role mapping screens and error states, 3) migration path for customers with old SDKs and recommended rollback. Plan a 60m slot: 30m demo/walkthrough + 30m Q&A.

Sam K.: +1. I can present the SDK changes. Prefer Wed or Thu next week (PST).

Taylor: Thu morning is best for me. Also request an agenda item for canary routing & telemetry signals (we need agreement on metrics).

Jen L.: I can assemble the pre-read checklist and reviewer smoke tests. Draft checklist is in the doc, copied here:

``
Pre-read checklist:
- Read API proposal (sections A-C)
- Inspect console mockups (frames 1-5)
- Migration + rollback notes
- Expected perf/latency for auth handshake
- Canary/telemetry: list of metrics to collect
``

Link to doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/sdks/2026-sdk-auth-console-pre-read

Alex R.: Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon 10:30-11:30
- Wed 14:00-15:00
- Thu 09:30-10:30
React with :thumbsup: on preferred slot or reply with conflicts.

Maria: :thumbsup: Thu 09:30 works for me. Please expand migration section with an example helm/manifest snippet.

Sam K.: Mon conflicts for me. Wed is possible but I prefer Thu 09:30. I opened a tiny PR for the API shape (`pkg/sdk/auth/session.go`) and requested review.

Taylor: Thu 09:30 ok. Adding "rollback triggers" to agenda (cache invalidation was an open risk).

Jen L.: Done — I updated agenda + added reviewer roles and a short smoke test spec at the bottom of the doc. Also added acceptance criteria for the console errors.

CI-bot: doc build: \u2705 passed for branch `feature/sdk-auth` — https://ci.internal/builds/5543

Alex R.: Locking Thu 09:30 PST. Calendar invite will come from calendar@redwood.io. I'll post a final pre-read summary by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :calendar:
